co_primary.definition: number of the nine blocks whose tracked component is continuous and intact at the horizon
co_primary.name: ITT_TRACK_CONTINUITY

decision_rules_sealed.IMPROVES: paired sign test on UCR vs PARENT with p < 0.05 AND positive median difference AND ITT continuity not below PARENT's AND futile fraction not above PARENT's + 0.10 AND shadow-0.55 survival not below PARENT's
decision_rules_sealed.SAFE_ABSTENTION: delivered mass below 0.5 x PARENT's AND UCR not significantly above PARENT's. Such an arm is never reported as an improvement.
decision_rules_sealed.TRACKER_GAMING_DETECTED: official survival at or above PARENT's while shadow-0.55 survival is below PARENT's, OR median fraction of tracked cells with m - THRESH < 0.05 above 0.5

design.independent_unit: one block = one (size, seed) lineage. Internal events are NEVER replicates.
design.status: DISCOVERY. These seeds were used in P07. Confirmation uses never-used seeds.
design.t256_states: the P07 checkpoints, SHA-256 verified against p07a_manifest.json before use

factorial.ceil: the source never fills a cell above this value
factorial.chosen_a_priori: round values, not tuned; eps=0.05 places the floor at 0.50, which is exactly one of the shadow thresholds, making the adversarial shadow test maximally severe
factorial.floor: the sink never leaves a cell it drains below this value

firewall.WHEN: identical in every arm: 320 events, spacing 16, first 272, last 5376
firewall.WHERE: identical in every arm: the frozen C256 downstream/upstream half masks
firewall.note: the feedback phase 08C varies only WHEN; a spatial phase, if it is opened at all, would vary only WHERE

primary_endpoint.analysis: median over the NINE blocks per size, intention to treat, blocks that lose the track keep the replacement they achieved and are never dropped; paired exact sign test against PARENT
primary_endpoint.definition: UCR = min( incumbent mass removed by the sink and never re-counted , fresh mass still inside the tracked component at the horizon ) / M256
primary_endpoint.name: UNIQUE_CAUSAL_REPLACEMENT
primary_endpoint.why_not_delivered_mass: P07 proved DELIVERED_FRACTION is inflatable by a futile cycle. UCR was adversarially validated on the P07 arms before this protocol was sealed: it ranks both known-degenerate arms (SRC_SINKSIDE 0.104, TRACKALL 0.251) below PARENT (0.387) and gives 0 to any arm whose component is dead at the horizon.

prohibitions_carried_forward: internal events are never independent replicates
the nine blocks stay in every ITT analysis including after track loss
survivors are never presented as the complete cohort
delivered mass is a diagnostic, never a substitute for exchange
an arm that survives by acting almost never is SAFE_ABSTENTION, not an improvement
no life / identity / autonomy / metabolism / organisation claim is fabricated

shadow_readers_predeclared.rule: the official tracker stays frozen at 0.45 and is the ONLY one used for endpoints; the shadow readers can only invalidate a survival, never create one

why_these_arms: The P08 audit found that 4036/4036 P07 rejections fall in exactly one category: the allowed support still holds matter (median 24.2 units) but all of it below THRESH. Global exhaustion 0/4036. Supra-threshold matter stranded outside the track 0/4036. The limit is LOCAL_SUBTHRESHOLD_INACCESSIBILITY_IN_A_FIXED_SUPPORT and the operator manufactures it. The amount rule therefore reduces to two numbers and a 2x2 factorial answers whether the useful correction is on the sink side, the source side, both, or neither.
